thinking:
*   Client: 洁家家政 (Jie Jia Home Services), a home cleaning service in Beijing.
    *   Target Audience: Busy families, working adults.
    *   Pages Required: Home (index.html), Services (services.html), About (about.html), Booking (booking.html).
    *   Language: Simplified Chinese.
    *   Design Constraints: Static site, relative links, no external CSS/JS/Fonts, responsive but optimized for 1440px, no placeholders, no AI mentions.
    *   Goal: Professional look, encouraging bookings.

    *   *Home Page (index.html):* Hero section with CTA, benefits of the service, trust signals (satisfied clients), link to services/booking.
    *   *Services Page (services.html):* Detailed packages (Basic, Deep, Move-in/out), pricing table, what's included.
    *   *About Page (about.html):* Company mission, quality standards, staff training/vetting process.
    *   *Booking Page (booking.html):* Form for service selection, address, date/time, contact info.

    *   *Color Palette:* Clean whites, soft blues/greens (representing cleanliness/freshness), dark grey for text.
    *   *Typography:* Sans-serif system fonts.
    *   *Layout:* Header (Logo + Nav), Main Content, Footer.

    *   *Index.html:*
        *   Headline: "让您的家焕然一新" (Make your home brand new).
        *   Sub-headline: "北京专业家政服务，为您打造舒适、洁净的居住环境。" (Professional home services in Beijing, creating a comfortable and clean living environment for you.)
        *   CTA: "立即预约" (Book Now).

    *   *Services.html:*
        *   Basic Cleaning (基础保洁): 150-250 RMB/session.
        *   Deep Cleaning (深度保洁): 300-600 RMB/session.
        *   Move-in Cleaning (开荒保洁): 20-40 RMB/sqm.
        *   Detailed lists of tasks (dusting, vacuuming, kitchen/bathroom scrubbing).

    *   *About.html:*
        *   Story: Founded in Beijing to solve the "busy professional" problem.
        *   Values: Trust, Professionalism, Efficiency.
        *   Staff: Background checks, professional training, certified cleaners.

    *   *Booking.html:*
        *   Form fields: Name, Phone, Address (District), Service Type, Preferred Date, Special Requirements.

    *   Ensure no external links.
    *   Embed CSS in `<style>` tags.
    *   Check navigation links.
    *   Verify Simplified Chinese characters.
    *   Ensure no "Lorem ipsum".
